title: Normalized restricted integral scalar units rationalize canonically
statement: Let l be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, E a finite coefficient stage and T any scheme. Let S be a restricted integral identity scalar functor with the included functor equality hS and inverse realization hχ prescribed by the coefficient construction. If e is an identity isomorphism of S whose ambient realization is the adjunction-normalized multiplication unit, then rationalization of its component at every finite-Tor integral object K is heterogeneously equal to the specified sfRationalScalarUnit component at rationalization(K). This compares scalar units on one scheme and contains no exceptional functor, compactification, coefficient comparison square or identity coherence assertion.

source.place: Integral-to-rational scalar identity: the multiplication-normalized restricted unit localizes to the rational unitor. The proof follows the scalar-extension composition identity normalization.

proof.text: Use the integral scalar-unit normalization theorem to identify the underlying arrows. The included functor equality identifies their source objects. Faithfulness of the full-subcategory inclusion then lifts the comparison to intrinsic integral arrows.
Apply raw rational localization to the intrinsic integral comparison. The component specification of sfRationalScalarUnit identifies the localized integral unit with the rational unit component.

theorem normalized_integral_scalar_unit
    (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l) (T : Scheme.{max u v})
    (S : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω (s := .integral E) (t := .integral E)
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier E.carrier
        (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier)) T)
    (hS : S.functor ⋙ RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) =
      RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) ⋙
        integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E.carrier E.carrier
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T)
    (hχ : ∀ K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E),
      HEq (S.realization.inv.app K)
        ((completedScalarComparison l E.carrier E.carrier
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T).app K.obj))
    (h : ∀ W : Scheme.{max u v},
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier E.carrier
        (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier)).map W = 𝟙 _)
    (e : ScalarIdentity.{u, v} l Ω h T S)
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E)) :
    HEq ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E T).map (e.iso.hom.app K))
      ((sfRationalScalarUnit l E.carrier T 0 (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero).hom.app
        ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E T).obj K))
